question: Which law was studied in the year 1787, in which it was said that as the volume of a gas increases its absolute temperature, if its absolute temperature decreases, then its volume will decrease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charles's law**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Charles's law** was studied in the year 1787.
 
• This law states that the volume of a gas is directly proportional to its absolute temperature, provided the pressure remains constant.
